answer.rationale: Incumbent refused a price reopen and the primary contract dies in 14 days with no auto-renew, so renew/negotiate/defer either miss the 18% spend cut or open a supply gap. The low-cost quote is the only path that meets the mandate on TCO. memory_c2 is the load-bearing prior: a primary move to that vendor cut cost with quick onboarding; that must be checked before treating delivery risk as unchanged. memory_c1 still warns that incumbent renewal was the no-interruption path. Line at 94% with zero buffer means any cutover can hit assembly, so this is not an unguarded broad rollout and add_second_source cannot replace the expiring primary in a one-decision cycle.
